tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Purchasing And Installating a new pumpset for the Filter Bed in Nalatawad Town

itemList.description: Dismantling of Existing Pump and allied acessories like manifold,Valves ,Cables etc,the dismantelled materials are removed from thepump pits and disposed to the required distance as directed by Engineer in charge .the  rate is inclusive of labour machineries etc.,with all lead and lift

25 HP or Suitable HP C/F Motor  The work includes Supply ,erection ,electrification and commissioning of 25HP or Suitable HP Split case Centrifugal Motor with all necessary acessories to required head and discharge and other technical Specifications etc.

25 HP or Suitable HP C/F Pump  The work includes Supply ,erection ,electrification and commissioning of 25HP or Suitable HP Split case Centrifugal Pump with all necessary acessories to required head and discharge and other technical Specifications etc.Duty Condition  Capable of delivering 884 LPM of Treated or Turbid Water containing turbidity upto 4000 PPM against a total head of 54 mtr.

Erection of pumpsets Erection of centrifugal pumpset using suitable size , plate girders, bolts and nuts, washers etc., complete. as required by the site condition and fixing of discharge head in position true to line, maintaining horizontal alignment, dynamic balancing and linkiong to delivery line using delivery pipes. Proper packing of the holes in the walls after laying pipe with cement concrete 1:1.5:3 with requisite steel reinforcement etc., complete.The erection of pumpsets comprising of one existing motor and with new pump.
